meta.name: invoice
meta.description: 标准发票: 寄件/收件 + 明细 + 税 + 总额 + 付款指引

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成标准发票，包含明细、税额和付款指引
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成符合税务规范的发票
copy.tagline_en: Generate standard invoices with line items, tax, and payment instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate tax-compliant invoices

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能生成一张 A4 可打印的标准发票，包含发票号、日期、寄件/收件方、明细表格、税额、总额和付款指引。
howto.when: 当你需要开具正式发票，或要求生成包含明细、税额和付款信息的打印版单据时触发。

say.text: 帮我开一张发票，收件人是ABC公司，金额5000元。
say.note: Claude 会生成含明细和税额的发票。

say.text: 生成一份带付款指引的发票，寄件方是我，收件方是客户。
say.note: Claude 会包含付款账户等信息。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate a standard A4 printable invoice with invoice number, date, from/bill-to, line items table, tax breakdown, totals, and payment instructions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need a formal invoice or request a printable document with line items, tax, and payment details.

say_en.text: Create an invoice for ABC Company, amount $5000.
say_en.note: Claude will generate an invoice with details and tax.

say_en.text: Generate an invoice with payment instructions, from me to a client.
say_en.note: Claude will include payment account info.
